Title: Data analyst
We are looking for an experienced data analyst who can organise our data within Zoho (Books, Creator, CRM, Subscriptions, etc.) to produce meaningful reports using Zoho Analytics at the request of our marketing, operations and finance teams. The ideal candidate will have SQL experience and will be able to convert a brief from the relevant stakeholders into an easily digestible format to help us make informed decisions at a senior management level. text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and excited to support teams that want clearer data and better decisions.

I’m Mina Castellan, a data analyst with 5 years of experience working across SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. Your role stood out to me because it combines exactly the kind of work I enjoy most: organising messy operational data, translating stakeholder requests into practical reporting, and turning that into something senior teams can actually use.

I’d be a strong fit for your Zoho Analytics work because I’m comfortable handling data from different systems, structuring it cleanly, and building reports that are easy to understand for marketing, operations, and finance. I also have solid SQL experience, which is essential for working across platforms like Zoho Books, Creator, CRM, and Subscriptions and shaping the data into a reliable reporting layer. I’m used to taking a brief from non-technical stakeholders and turning it into a clear, digestible output that supports better decision-making.

One relevant project was Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, where I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work helped reallocate 18% of the ad budget and contributed to a 12% reduction in customer acquisition cost the next quarter. It’s a good example of how I approach analytics: organize the data carefully, ask the right questions, and present findings in a format that supports action.

For your home repairs business, I’d focus on creating dependable reporting in Zoho Analytics that gives each team the visibility they need without unnecessary complexity. Whether the request comes from marketing, operations, or finance, I can help convert it into useful dashboards and reports that highlight the most important trends and metrics.

I’m also interested in long-term work, so this ongoing opportunity is especially appealing. I’d welcome the chance to contribute consistently and help build a reporting setup that scales with your growth across the UK, London, and South Africa.

If you’d like, I’d be happy to discuss how I can help structure and deliver your Zoho reporting needs.
